title: 20 Years Of Money Advice in 22 Minutes (How I Made Millions)
promo_conflict: Career and mindset advice video on the creator's own channel. It pushes a downloadable hiring matrix ('If you want to link, it's down below') that feeds Codie Sanchez's personal brand. No business is described in workable detail.

idea.name: Codie Sanchez's current operating company (unspecified)
idea.one_liner: A company the speaker built that 'runs before I step foot in the door'. Its offer, customers and revenue model are never described.

key_quotes.quote: So it took me 40 years to get to the point where I built a company that actually runs before I step foot in the door.
But when you own your own company and get to set the culture, it's important to set the expectations as well.

ideas.delivery: not stated (has an in-person office team; staff described working weekends)

idea.name: Investment banking career at Goldman Sachs
idea.one_liner: A job in finance won by self-advocacy, not a business. Pay was salary plus bonuses and deal commissions.

key_quotes.quote: I flew myself to a golden sax headquarters in person for a role.
You know, when I walked into Goldman as a public school kid, I was in a room full of people who'd been preparing for that opportunity.
The rest came from me betting on myself, doing bonuses, asking for commissions on deals.

claims.claim: Starting salary out of college was $37K a year
claims.quote: So I came out of college making 37K a year.

claims.claim: Was earning seven figures as a partner by the time she left finance
claims.quote: By the time I left finance, I was making seven figures as a partner, and that was working for somebody else who was still an employee.

claims.claim: Salary was only about 20% of total compensation
claims.quote: Salary was only about 20% of what I actually made.

acquisition_channels.details: Flew to Goldman HQ at her own expense and did two days of interviews plus a live PowerPoint presentation

ideas.delivery: Employee work at an investment bank

idea.name: Pursuing a Credit Suisse role
idea.one_liner: A job pursuit in finance, not a business. The contact made there later helped raise millions for an unnamed venture.

key_quotes.quote: And then when I wanted to hit the big leagues and go to Credit Suisse, one of the biggest investment firms in the world, I flew myself on my own dime to three continents.

claims.claim: A Credit Suisse contact later helped her raise millions of dollars for another venture
claims.quote: He helped me eventually raise millions of dollars for something else.

acquisition_channels.details: Flew to London, New York and San Francisco at her own expense to meet partners

ideas.delivery: Employee work at an investment bank

idea.name: Speaker's first company (unspecified)
idea.one_liner: The speaker's first company, started without a plan and promoted by word of mouth and conference stickers. Its offer and revenue are never described.

key_quotes.quote: I plastered my company over every conversation I could.
I remember putting stickers at a conference to get the word out.

acquisition_channels.details: Mentioned the company in every conversation and put stickers up at a conference

idea.name: Own an asset management company
idea.one_liner: Named as one of five ways to get rich: running an asset management firm that earns fees on managed capital. No detail is given.

key_quotes.quote: You inherit it, you marry it, you become a Fortune 500 exec, you own an asset management company or your own a business.

ideas.other_uk_rules: Managing investments in the UK requires FCA authorisation under FSMA 2000. Investor data falls under UK GDPR.
